title: Star Wars: Troopers, Sabers & Governments
script: This is a Clone Trooper. This is a Stormtrooper. So what's the difference? Clone Troopers are genetically identical soldiers for the Republic. Stormtroopers are conscripted or recruited soldiers for the Empire. This is a Lightsaber. This is a Darksaber. So what's the difference? A Lightsaber is a plasma blade used by Force-sensitives. A Darksaber is a unique, black-bladed lightsaber, an ancient Mandalorian relic. This is the Republic. This is the Empire. So what's the difference? The Republic was a democratic government. The Empire was a tyrannical regime. Follow for more.
